name: Paging identity: TV(full, paged) = evicted router mass, paged attention from a real kernel pass
details: Pre-registered criterion met (max abs error between the TV distance and the evicted router mass is within the tolerance, DEV-U8). The harness flag is false because the auxiliary SDPA-vs-(a_paged @ v) check exceeds 1e-5 absolute; reported literally. 9 paged kernel passes (the kernel hides the evicted origins' keys from the tail's query rows in one layer; layers [0, 18, 35]), 81 (layer, head, query, resident subset) cases: TV between the full pass's and the paged pass's attention vs the evicted router mass: max abs difference 3.33e-16; paged SDPA output vs a_paged @ v 2.08e-05; q,k,v of the two passes differ by 0.0e+00; weight on evicted keys 0.0e+00 (tolerance 1e-05, fp32); evicted masses covered 5.16e-16 to 1.
criterion: Paging identity: total-variation distance between full and paged attention equals the evicted router mass (tolerance <= 1e-5 in fp32; protocol 5.1 table as adopted by the registration Section 9)
harness_criterion: max abs error <= 1e-5 in fp32 (TV vs evicted mass, paged output vs a_paged @ v)
preregistered_criterion: Paging identity: total-variation distance between full and paged attention equals the evicted router mass (tolerance <= 1e-5 in fp32; protocol 5.1 table as adopted by the registration Section 9)
